51610188.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to TRIP13 (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation rate constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPR assays: SPR assays were carried out as in previous experiments. The TRIP13 protein was dissolved in 10 mM sodium acetate (pH 4.5), and then 200 μg/mL protein was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip until 20,000 RU was reached. Subsequently, tested compounds were diluted with a PBS buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA) using two-fold dilution steps, to give 10 concentration gradients in a range between (0.049–25 μM). Furthermore, 10 μM different concentrations of samples were flowed over the chip at the rate of 30 mL/minute. The binding Kinetics of compounds were recorded at 25 °C on the Biacore™ 8 K instrument (Cytiva), and affinity (K_D), association rate constant (k_a), and dissociation rate constant (k_d) were calculated using a 1:1 interaction model via Biacore™ 8 K evaluation software (Cytiva).
